3250 divided by 18 is shown as quotient 179 and remainder 28. Which check can be used to find the mistake? A. quotient x divisor + remainder = dividend  B. remainder < dividend  C. remainder = divisor
questions.source_issue: DEFECTIVE_PRINTED_ITEM: 18 x 179 + 28 = 3250, so option A's reconstruction check passes; remainder < dividend also passes but is not the standard remainder bound. The violated rule is 0 <= remainder < divisor. Actual 3250 / 18 = 180 R10. No printed option states the complete standard rule.

questions.source_issue: SEMANTICALLY_INVALID_STORY: speeds of separate animals are not normally added to form one collective speed. The workbook's intended arithmetic is 9 equal groups of 109 = 981.
